name: Buddha's Folly Poker
description: Buddha's Folly is a stud poker variant played with match-pot betting. Each player receives five cards face down. The dealer offers one card at a time to the left; players may accept it and discard one face up to the next player, or reject and pass the card on. When a card is rejected by everyone it returns to its originator. Players then declare in or out; those in show hands and the best five-card hand wins the pot; losers who stayed in pay the match pot for the next deal.

Five cards face down to each player. Dealer then offers one card at a time from the deck to the player to the left; that player accepts (and discards one to the next) or passes the card on. Card-offer continues until a card has been rejected by everyone and returns to its originator.
